name: triss-red-pt
author: Speedtreee
description: Fork of jlrouzies-fr triss-aio-020 (Hairwork for All). Red/ginger root + tip colour instead of brown, warmer specular, and 12 instead of 20 CVs per guide (kept CVs picked to hug the scalp) for about 40% less path-traced hair cost in close-ups. Same guides, faces and physics. Needs Hairwork for All Core and the long hair Triss mod (Nexus 6457).
